notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Update - New Content!
notes.content:
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added a new level, Hungry House!  This level is selectable under "Bonus Levels".
[*]There's a new set of achievements alongside a leaderboard for Hungry House, same as all other levels.
[*]Want to get involved with the community?  We've added a button to the credits menu that will send you to our official Discord server!
[*]A new skin can be unlocked by doing something in Hungry House, but only after beating the game.
[*]The free soundtrack now includes "Huh2" and "I'm Hungry".  More Beats!  More Tunes!
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes/Patch Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Adjusted an effect on the main menu to increase framerate on Steam Decks and computers using graphics cards with less than 4GB of VRAM.
[*]Volcanic Void has received another optimization pass (this does not affect any level geometry or gameplay).
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Update + OST Release
notes.content:
Hello rats, chairs, and rat chairs (???)!  We are pleased to announce that the CHAIRS OST is now out as a free add-on!  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3078940/CHAIRS_Soundtrack/?curator_clanid=43880807]Click here to add the soundtrack to your library[/url]!  Now, go forth and enjoy listening to some defined BEATS and TUNES!

Below you can also find some patch notes for the game.

[h2]Bug Fixes/Minor Patches[/h2]

[list]
[*]The camera now moves at a consistent speed for the final cutscene regardless of V-Sync settings.
[*]Added an arrow to the HUD in the Appliance Avenue tutorial segments to help highlight the charge indicator.
[*]Reworked most in-game UI to support widescreen displays better.
[*]Modified text on the initial warning screen to highlight an accessibility option that may help some players.
[/list]

tags.bug: The camera now moves at a consistent speed for the final cutscene regardless of V-Sync settings.

tags.feature: Added an arrow to the HUD in the Appliance Avenue tutorial segments to help highlight the charge indicator.
Reworked most in-game UI to support widescreen displays better.

tags.bug: Modified text on the initial warning screen to highlight an accessibility option that may help some players.
